points.quote: `packages/common/` holds code shared by client and server: `nbstore` (storage and sync), `graphql` (schema and client), `infra`, `env`, ...
**`tools/`** holds the CLI (`affine`), the build/bundle scripts, and changelog and commit tooling. ... `tests/` (end-to-end)
Web: `apps/web`, plus `apps/mobile`, which is the mobile-web build. Desktop: `apps/electron` ... Mobile: `apps/ios` and `apps/android` ... `admin` is the server admin panel.
`native` and `mobile-native` are Rust bindings for the desktop and mobile clients. ... `native` (`@affine/server-native`) is its Rust module.
It is the backend for cloud and self-hosted use. AFFiNE is local-first, so clients keep working offline and the server syncs and stores the data.
**PostgreSQL**, via Prisma. The schema uses the pgvector extension ... **Redis**. ... GraphQL and REST APIs.
